title: 第476章 火护山
slug: 穿越源卡大陆我自带融合卡牌
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

火护山，

位于铁矿山脉与灰烬之森的夹缝之间。

因常年有卡兽过来游荡，一直以来都被划为无人区。

早年更是被火护犬族群占领过，也因此得名火护山。

直到十几年前，

黑曜公国老公爵去世。

公国内发生激烈的领地争夺，战火席卷四方。

不少村庄和三级城镇被摧毁，那些无家可回的平民便一路迁徙。

其中也有不少人和低阶御卡师来到火护山，克服了种种困难，从这座山头定居下来。

而罗根就是当初那些人中的一员。

劲风拂过，

一头威猛的黄金狮鹫在天际划破一道白痕。

“那家伙说，摩罗斯将他们山寨给收编了，并且层层筛选，不合格的全都喂火护犬。

剩下的人就开始搞一些特训，并且经常带他们打劫各种商队，几年时间就死了近七成的人…………”

听到杰克的讲述，林奇眼神中透着一丝寒意。

“普通山匪只求财货，就算内部会有争斗，也绝不会如此不计损耗的消耗人手。”

“所以，那家伙并不是泥腿子出身。

他背后必然有势力暗中支持，目的就是练兵，要打造一支精锐。”

杰克也是点头赞同。

“的确有这种可能。

尤其是他们自称火护军团。

哪怕黑曜公国民风彪悍，可一方山寨的强盗也绝不敢冠以军团之名，这名号太过逾矩。”

“就是不知道，那个军团背后的支持者是谁。”

林奇声音冷冽：“是谁已经不重要了。”

贵族喜欢培养私兵，这种事情是常有的，无论是谁，林奇都会让他们付出代价。

很快，皇家狮鹫便飞到了火护山地界。

放眼望去，整座山头都被密林覆盖，山林沟壑纵横，特别适合隐匿藏身。

杰克眺望远方，皱眉道：

“按照那家伙的说法，他们寨子的据点有三个，我们无法确定他们首领现在位于哪一个据点。”

林奇左眼闪烁幽光，打量着这层层叠叠的密林。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Fire protects mountains,

Located between the Iron Ore Mountains and the Ash Forest.

It has always been classified as a no-man's land because of the constant presence of card animals.

In the early years, it was occupied by the Fire Guard Dog tribe, hence the name Fire Guard Mountain.

Until more than ten years ago,

The old Duke of Obsidian Principality passed away.

Fierce competition for territory broke out in the principality, and war swept across all directions.

Many villages and third-level towns were destroyed, and the homeless civilians migrated along the way.

Many of them and low-level card masters came to Huohu Mountain, overcame various difficulties, and settled down on this mountain.

And Logan was one of those people back then.

The strong wind blows,

A mighty golden griffon cut a white streak in the sky.

"The guy said that Moros had integrated their copycats and screened them at all levels, and all the unqualified ones were fed to the fire protection dogs.

The remaining people began to engage in special training, and often led them to rob various caravans. Within a few years, nearly 70% of them died..."

Hearing Jack's story, Lynch had a chill in his eyes.

"Ordinary bandits only want wealth. Even if there are internal battles, they will never consume manpower without regard to losses."

“So, that guy is not from a mud-legged background.

There must be forces secretly supporting him, and the purpose is to train troops and build an elite force."

Jack also nodded in agreement.

“It is indeed possible.

Especially since they call themselves the Fire Guardians.

Even though the folk customs of the Obsidian Principality are fierce, the bandits in the village would never dare to call them a legion. This name is too out of line."

"I just don't know who is behind that legion."

Lynch's voice was cold: "It doesn't matter who it is anymore."

Nobles like to cultivate private soldiers. This kind of thing is common. No matter who they are, Lynch will make them pay the price.

Soon, the Royal Griffin flew to the boundary of Huohu Mountain.

Looking around, you can see that the entire mountain is covered with dense forests, and the mountains are crisscrossed with ravines, which are particularly suitable for hiding.

Jack looked into the distance and frowned:

"According to what that guy said, there are three strongholds in their village. We can't determine which stronghold their leader is currently located at."

Lin Qi's left eye flashed with light as he looked at the layers of dense forest.
